caption:
Something needs saying — but you fear it'll wound? Say it as family. (1 Timothy 5:1–2 devotional)

The content of the correction may be the same — but shaming and exhorting as family build two different people. The church isn't an organization to manage; it's a family to build up. Ask not “who's right” but “how do I build them up?”
